0.literal: (Maybe I should head over toward the front of the theater...)

1.literal: Bro... even if you say you're going to leave the family,
1.official: Bro... Just because you say you want out

2.literal: you'd better be prepared for it.
2.official: doesn't mean Kuze's gonna just let you go.

3.literal: Maybe that informant, too, has been bought off.
3.official: he's paid them all enough to keep quiet. If he's really the kind of guy they say he is, it's possible.

4.literal: Damn, should I fight back with money of my own...?
4.official: Shit... Wonder if there's any way to outspend him.

5.literal: Then get out there and rake up the information on your own two feet!
5.official: Then get the hell out there and find me some information!

6.literal: Don't rely on the informants anymore!

7.literal: And I found them so handy since they were open till morning...
7.official: Them being open all night was a huge deal.

8.literal: I wonder if they did a moonlight flit...
8.official: Think the guy running the place just skipped town?

10.literal: Boss, this is the building our company's Kamurocho branch is
10.official: This is the building our new Kamurocho branch is opening in

12.literal: You really managed to land such a great spot!
12.official: I'm impressed we were able to land such a prime spot!

13.literal: Once we asked them, it was settled in no time.
13.official: Then we reached out to Tachibana Real Estate and it all came together in no time.

14.literal: It seems long-established popular shops used to be the tenants here, but
14.official: All the tenants were established businesses, and popular still, but

15.literal: in less than a month it was a vacant tenancy.
15.official: within a month, the place was vacant.

16.literal: But the people who were forced out against their will,

17.literal: I kind of feel sorry for them...
17.official: I feel kind of bad for everybody who got forced out...

18.literal: What are you talking about? On top of getting a relocation fee,
18.official: Why? They got paid a relocation fee, and

19.literal: they even had replacement locations arranged for them, you know?
19.official: Tachibana Real Estate found them all new locations.

20.literal: If anything, the shops that moved out ought to be thanking us.

21.literal: Ah, another shop already moved in there ahead of us.
21.official: Yeah, but another business beat us to it.

22.literal: If I knew of jobs like that, I'd be doing them myself first...
22.official: If I did, I'd be doin' em myself.

24.literal: Maybe I can get the details out of him.
24.official: A homeless guy who worked with Tachibana Real Estate might have some info.

25.literal: I saw him carrying a 10,000-yen note.
25.official: I saw this filthy bum with a 10G note a bit ago.

27.literal: Ah, but no good, going all the way there is such a pain...
27.official: Ehh, fuck it. The park's too far. I'm tired...

29.literal: Delinquent with no mind of his own

32.literal: Hey, hurry up and lend me the money.
32.official: C'mon, hand over the money. I told you I'd pay you back when I can, didn't I?

35.literal: Just shut up and hand it over already!

37.literal: (Guess I'll teach them a little lesson...)
37.official: Somebody needs to set them straight before they try anything really stupid.

38.literal: Hey... isn't that guy a yakuza?
38.official: Wait, are you sure he's not yakuza?

39.literal: Guys who are used to walking around Kamurocho

40.literal: wouldn't do anything stupid around here.
40.official: you'd know better than to do anything stupid here.

41.literal: Don't go preaching at us all high and mighty, yakuza!
41.official: Where's a piece of yakuza trash get off lecturing us!?

44.literal: Still, man, you've really started to look the part.
44.official: I'll admit, though, you're finally starting to look the part.

45.official: You make a pretty convincing yakuza.

47.literal: This ought to put Kazama-san's mind at ease a bit.
47.official: That should put Kazama-san's mind at ease a bit.

49.literal: What are you saying? It's such a ridiculous era, isn't it?
49.official: Please. You see the times we're living in?

50.literal: You'd be a fool not to enjoy it. Use your head a little...
50.official: You'd be crazy not to enjoy all this, bro! Learn to use your head a bit.

51.literal: As for Kazama-san getting out of the slammer,

52.literal: it won't be until after the new year.
52.official: Once the new year rolls around,

53.literal: By then I'll have become a bit more skilled myself.
53.official: I'll try to learn a few new tricks by then.

54.literal: Then start by changing that shabby getup of yours.
54.official: Yeah? How about we start with those rags you're wearing?

55.literal: Even Kazama-san always wears plain clothes, doesn't he.
55.official: Besides, Kazama-san never wore flashy clothes.

56.literal: Come on, that man is the family's captain...
56.official: You do realize he's the family captain, right?

57.literal: The number two of the Dojima Family, you know?
57.official: Number two in the whole Dojima operation?

58.literal: So that car you bought recently was for that "image" too, huh.
58.official: So that fancy new car you bought was just "business"?

61.literal: ...All right, let's hit Pink Street for once.
61.official: What say we mix things up, hit Pink Street tonight? I know a nice little spot over there.

62.literal: You got some kind of complaint?
62.official: What's yer problem, bro? You got a... a problem?

63.literal: We're having an important talk here right now!
63.official: We're in the middle of some... 'portant business!
